description: This file defines classes related to managing camera stream buffers and native handles in the Android hardware camera implementation, including a wrapper for release fences and a cached stream buffer class.

classes.name: ReleaseFence
classes.description: A small wrapper class for allocating and freeing native fence handles.

classes.name: CachedStreamBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a cached buffer of camera stream data, including import/export of fences and buffer validity checks.

methods.name: ReleaseFence
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the fence with a file descriptor, and destructor that releases resources.

methods.name: CachedStreamBuffer
methods.description: Constructors, destructor, and move semantics for managing camera stream buffers.

methods.name: importFence
methods.description: Imports a fence handle into the buffer object.

methods.name: acquireAsYUV
methods.description: Returns the buffer data as YUV layout after waiting on the acquire fence.

methods.name: acquireAsBlob
methods.description: Returns the buffer data as a blob after waiting on the acquire fence.
